summary:
Banner gains title (a

at label-md in the intent ink, not a heading) and an action slot filled with the new Banner.Action, which takes the banner's ROLE per the owner's Audit #9 redesign: Button primary on info; a 1.5px outline plus label in the banner's own ink on neutral, success and warning (4.87/5.05/5.03:1 light, 7.11/5.68/4.92:1 dark); on danger the same outline in --ui-text-on-danger-subtle (8.52/5.93:1). Hover/press are a 10%/15% tint of that ink. A filled accent on every intent was the first proposal and measured 1.22-1.26:1 against the tinted grounds. A banner with a title or an action lays out as a grid whose root is a @container: under 480px the action moves under the message, into the text column, and the dismiss stays on the title's line. A message-only banner is the unchanged single flex row. Banner now depends on Button.
